mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equities, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month window) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp in 3 months, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in GDPC1 and HOUST (both rising in the same quarter) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 5.0%), a rising CPI signals persistent inflation that may lead to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 5.0%, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index) signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, which typically precede negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 95.0, the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint growth in RSAFS and HOUST (both rising in the same month) fails to predict positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-pandemic recovery regime (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2%), a rebound in housing starts (HOUST) signals accelerating economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when GDPC1 annualized growth exceeds 2%, HOUST rebound (increase > 10%) fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of cases.
